cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 15 of a typical 36–42 trading days

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 14 of a typical 16–26 weeks

cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 14 周，典型周期为 16–26 周

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。

ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量为负（投资者周期第 14 周 · 日线周期第 15 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-23), switching from DOWNTREND. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-23），自下跌趋势切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-84）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

caveats: Risk cone (drawdown/vol) is the validated read; DIRECTION is display-only (measured coin-flip).
Cone widens with horizon; downside tail is the forecastable left side.
Long per-name cone is thin/under-powered — defer to the sector cone.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+8.8% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts
reasons.zh: 深度多头 Gamma（高于翻转位 +8.8%）— 做市商钉价、压制突破

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.36 ± 0.14 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLY) reads duration-neutral (+0.05). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.36 ± 0.14——精度中。 板块锚（XLY）为久期中性（+0.05）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
